NOTES:
- `WorkflowSettingsClient.tsx` and the `web/app/teams/` directory didn't exist, so I had no call site to match. The component is untested beyond `tsc`.
- I deviated from the planned props. The plan says `stages: string[]`, but rows need `is_initial` and `is_terminal`, so `stages` is `StageDraft[]` (exported). I also added a `transitions: TransitionDraft[]` prop (exported), because a controlled editor has to receive the transitions it renders. T4a should import both types.
- `signoff_roles` and `signoff_min` appear only when `requires_signoff` is on. `signoff_min` is clamped to at least 1. An empty `allowed_kinds` means all kinds, and the UI says so.
